L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Greg Zuvich wrote:
> One, do most people out there play with tournament 6 card limit on TB since it
> is so silly?

"Tounrnament 6 card limit" is a misnomer. If you're playing with a
six card limit, then you're playing a house rule, not a tournament rule.

> Two, is there an actual ruling somewhere limiting it to 6 cards as per tourney
> for other silly cards like Majesty?

Official DCI tournament rules have no 6 card limit (or any other card
limit) on any cards. The old DCI rules (before Oct. 1995) had a 6CL
on Majesty, Freak Drive, Kine Resources Contested, etc.

But these limits were discarded in favor of fixing the rules that had
made the limits necessary. The fixes: No Repeat Actions, PAs burned
for votes are not replaced until the end of the turn.

> #six card limit, then you're playing a house rule, not a tournament rule.
>
> I did not mean to say there was limit on all cards, just certain ones like
> majesty.

I understand. But there is no limit on any cards, even Majesty.
Some cards are banned (Ante cards, Paralyze cards, and Monocle),
but other than that, there are nor restrictions on deck contruction
(except for card backs).

> #> Two, is there an actual ruling somewhere limiting it to 6 cards as per
> #tourney
> #> for other silly cards like Majesty?
> #

> #Official DCI tournament rules have no 6 card limit (or any other card
> #limit) on any cards. The old DCI rules (before Oct. 1995) had a 6CL
> #on Majesty, Freak Drive, Kine Resources Contested, etc.
>
> que?

There's no card limit, and no restricted list.

> #But these limits were discarded in favor of fixing the rules that had
> #made the limits necessary. The fixes: No Repeat Actions, PAs burned
> #for votes are not replaced until the end of the turn.
>

> what exactly does this mean? The same vampire cannot use more than one Freak
> Drive in a turn or the same PLAYER cannot use more than one in a turn?

The limit is on action types (Bleed, Vote, Hunt, etc.). A minion
cannot attempt an action of the same type more than once per turn.

> So, if a single vampire cannot use more than one of particular card in a turn,
> say Majesty, then if a combat is started over again with Psyche then Majesty
> could not be used by that vampire again to end the combat a second time?
> Likewise, if the combat was ended for yet a second time via some other card,
> then the other combatant could not use a second Psyche card?

The are no restrictions on anything but attempting actions.
You are free to use Majesty in as many combats per turn as you
like.
